normalization_rule: Canonical obligation registry and governed completion certificates control status; campaign dashboards and historical reports are subordinate projections and may be stale.

findings.title: B threshold obligation is bounded-discharged
findings.statement: OBL-D-001B has an approved completion certificate after independent reconstruction of 108 archived rows, exact archive matching, deterministic replay, and 21 threshold-sensitive cases.

findings.title: D promotion gate remains blocked
findings.statement: The D promotion gate remains blocked by unresolved C semantic-preservation support, D review and wording qualification, and E dependent gate review.
falsification_conditions: A valid certificate and required review are added for each remaining blocker.

findings.title: Stale subordinate campaign projections conflict with current B status
findings.statement: The current certificate and registry mark B DISCHARGED_BOUNDED, while human_review_approval_b_e_20260723.json, d_semantic_definition_matrix.json, and subordinate dashboard artifacts still describe B as open or undefined.
implicit_assumptions: The canonical registry and completion certificate are authoritative over subordinate campaign projections.
findings.recommended_next_action: Reconcile subordinate campaign projections, preserve their historical wording, and add supersession links rather than silently overwriting history.

findings.title: Bounded discharge versus theorem readiness
findings.statement: The corpus requires a distinct status separating obligation completion within a declared finite evidence scope from readiness for theorem promotion.
falsification_conditions: A governed status model demonstrates that bounded obligation discharge and promotion readiness are identical for all applicable obligations.
findings.recommended_next_action: Add the distinction to the analysis reporting schema or confirm an existing canonical status taxonomy.

open_research_debt.blocking_effect: Progress reporting consistency, not theorem validity

synthesis.hypothesis: Typed, context-indexed evidence can discharge local obligations without establishing a universal theorem; promotion readiness is a stricter conjunction of obligation completion, scope review, and dependency closure.
synthesis.mapping: immutable experiment specification -> recoverable bounded result -> independent reconstruction -> obligation certificate -> promotion gate audit
competing_explanations: The apparent threshold result may be an artifact of the finite synthetic grid.
Subordinate report conflict may reflect stale projections rather than a semantic disagreement.
synthesis.falsification_condition: A new independently checked result outside the declared finite grid invalidates the bounded interpretation or a canonical status rule collapses discharge and promotion readiness.

assessment.reason: The crawl verified the B discharge and current D gate while exposing stale subordinate projections and unresolved C/D/E work.

recommended_next_campaign.objective: Reconcile all subordinate D campaign projections with the current canonical obligation statuses while preserving historical records.
stopping_conditions: Every stale B reference is classified as current, superseded, or historical
No current report contradicts the canonical B status

termination_reason: Bounded delta scope exhausted; further progress requires reconciliation edits or new evidence.
